name: DBV12
description:
A smoothbore shotgun based off of the AK-12 pre-production variant, chambered for 12g shotgun shells. Unlike most of the other pre-production AK-12 variants, this one was officially announced in 2013 but never reached production. It was designed for the civilian sporting market.

Good rate of fire and damage, but somewhat high spread.

Model submitted by Rialag
